task_description: Production-grade notification architecture redesign for ArtNepalaya. Replaces per-event notification documents with time-windowed grouped notifications, push cooldowns, configurable parameters, and real-time group updates via Socket.IO. Covers backend model, service, migration, mobile client, and admin panel.

verification.summary: All 7 new/modified backend JS files pass node --check syntax validation. Mobile TypeScript errors are pre-existing (NativeStackNavigationProp, socket.io-client, expo-notifications type declarations) and not introduced by this change. notificationSlice.ts has zero errors. Admin panel TSX compiles cleanly. No test framework exists in this project so test_quality is assessed via code review of the implementation logic.
